speaker: Doctor
text: The normal hematocrit makes significant hemolysis unlikely. Given the exclusive breastfeeding and unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, this is most likely breast milk jaundice, but I must rule out G6PD deficiency given the family history. REQUEST TEST: G6PD Level, Blood Type of Mother and Baby
